summary: Full-stack testing of Sentinel project intelligence app. Backend: 7/7 pytest passing (health, check-scope IN/OUT/GREY, structure-scope, change-order). Frontend: landing page, 3-step wizard, board with seeded Lumière demo, add-task -> /api/check-scope, scope creep alert, change-order modal with typewriter + COPY button, scope/billing/client navigation all working. ONE CRITICAL VIOLATION found: 'Made with Emergent' badge IS present on every page despite explicit requirement that it must NOT appear.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Made with Emergent' badge IS rendered on every page (bottom-right). This explicitly violates the MVP spec: 'Made with Emergent badge does NOT appear anywhere'. The badge is injected by the platform — main agent must add the documented suppression hook (e.g. window.EMERGENT_HIDE_BADGE=true or the equivalent meta/script in /app/frontend/public/index.html) to remove it.

integration_issues.issue: Generated email contains literal 'Hi [Client Name],' placeholder despite the real client name being available in the project. Investigate whether ChangeOrderModal is actually passing project.client into the /api/generate-change-order payload, or whether Claude is being instructed to treat it as a placeholder. Minor — email still copies/sends, but unprofessional.

issues: Start Date field uses native browser date picker (<input type='date'>) instead of a styled shadcn/calendar component — inconsistent with the editorial sharp-edge design system and breaks the warm-palette / IBM Plex Mono visual language.

action_items: Remove the 'Made with Emergent' badge from the entire app (all routes). Use the documented suppression mechanism so it is not rendered on /, /new, /app/board, /app/scope, /app/billing, or /app/client.
Replace native <input type='date'> on /new step 1 (Start Date) with the project's shadcn Calendar/Popover component to keep the editorial design consistent.

Fix 'Hi [Client Name]' placeholder in change-order email — confirm ChangeOrderModal posts the active project's client name into the payload.client_name field, and tighten the system prompt so Claude substitutes the real value instead of echoing a bracketed placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 35: LLM_API_KEY falls back through ANTHROPIC_API_KEY before EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — fine, but log which one was selected at startup for debug clarity.

server.py /check-scope verdict parsing (line 174-180) is brittle: the upper().startswith() loop checks 'OUT_OF_SCOPE' first which is correct ordering, but the second condition `f' {v}' in raw.upper()[:80]` could double-match GREY_AREA inside 'OUT_OF_SCOPE' explanations. Worked in tests but consider tightening to a regex anchored on first token.
server.py CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is invalid per CORS spec and many browsers reject it — set explicit origins or set credentials False.
ChangeOrderModal: confirm payload includes project.client; placeholder suggests passing empty/literal string.
All interactive elements have data-testid — excellent test hygiene.

rca of the issue: Made with Emergent badge: the platform injects a global badge component unless suppressed. Implementation must add the supported opt-out (commonly window.EMERGENT_HIDE_BADGE = true in index.html before bundle load, or the documented data-attribute on body/root). Current /app/frontend/public/index.html does not include the suppression. Reproduce: visit any route — badge appears bottom-right on landing, /new and all /app/* pages. Mitigation: add the platform's documented suppression flag in /app/frontend/public/index.html (or call the SDK helper if exposed) and rebuild.
